mapper.select: SELECT idc.name AS dc FROM idc LEFT JOIN prom_server ps ON idc.id = ps.idc_id WHERE ps.type = 2 AND ps.status = 1 GROUP BY idc.id

SELECT idc.id as id, idc.name, count( ps.id ) AS promTotal, COUNT( CASE WHEN ps.STATUS = '1' or ps.STATUS = '-1' THEN 0 END ) AS promUp, COUNT( CASE WHEN ps.STATUS = '0' or ps.STATUS = '-2' THEN 0 END ) AS promDown FROM idc idc LEFT JOIN prom_server ps ON idc.id = ps.idc_id GROUP BY idc.id
